subject.title: Feature request: Support HarmonyOS/Huawei devices without GMS

question: Should OpenClaw support HarmonyOS/no-GMS Android by guaranteeing launch and manual/setup-code pairing without Google Play services, or also commit to a separate Huawei/AppGallery distribution and push stack?
rationale: Current code leaves a plausible Google Play services dependency path in first-run Android onboarding, while the requested AppGallery/Huawei Push path changes distribution and support scope beyond a narrow launch/setup fallback.

options.title: Scope a narrow no-GMS launch fallback
options.body: Keep the app launchable and pairable without Google Play services by guarding or replacing the scanner path and preserving manual/setup-code onboarding, while deferring AppGallery and Huawei Push.

options.title: Approve full Huawei distribution support
options.body: Own a no-GMS flavor plus AppGallery/Huawei Push Kit policy, release docs, signing/provenance, and real-device validation.

options.title: Do not support no-GMS Android now
options.body: Document Google Play or source-build support only and close no-GMS compatibility requests until Android distribution policy changes.

recommendation.title: Scope a narrow no-GMS launch fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the app launchable and pairable without Google Play services by guarding or replacing the scanner path and preserving manual/setup-code onboarding, while deferring AppGallery and Huawei Push.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans Android product scope and release/distribution policy, and the Android app plus release-surface history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate.
